questions.question: What must a repaired .blend import prove?
options: Preserve authored placement and verify the real path (Recommended)
Only stop the import from erroring
questions.answer: Preserve the model as authored and verify that .blend import actually works
questions.notes: User said the .blend import does not work as intended and asked for a fix plus verification.

questions.question: When should imported hierarchy transforms be measured?
options: After objects join the active scene (Recommended)
questions.assumed: Evaluate imported hierarchy after linking it into the active scene

questions.question: What should flattening do to object placement?
options: Bake exact world placement into vertices (Recommended)
Move every object to the origin without baking
questions.assumed: Bake exact world placement into editable vertices

questions.question: How should linked duplicates with shared mesh data flatten?
options: Make data single-user before distinct transforms (Recommended)
Keep shared data and let transforms compound
questions.assumed: Make mesh data single-user before applying per-object world transforms

questions.question: Should import still append into the open project?
Which Blender object types are in this repair?
options: Expand to cameras, lights, curves, and empties
questions.assumed: Keep mesh-only import and existing warnings for skipped types

questions.question: Should imported datablocks remain linked to the source file?
questions.assumed: Keep imported objects and mesh data local and editable

questions.question: What happens to geometry already in the project?
What transforms remain after Flatten is enabled?
options: Identity object transforms with baked vertices (Recommended)
Keep both baked vertices and object transforms
questions.assumed: Use identity object transforms after baking world placement once

questions.question: What should Flatten disabled preserve?
options: World placement on each detached mesh object (Recommended)
Parent dependencies that will be removed
questions.assumed: Preserve world matrices while detaching skipped parents

questions.question: When do source-axis and unit conversions apply?
questions.assumed: Apply axis and unit conversion after source world placement is known

questions.question: Should material assignments survive the repair?
options: Drop materials while copying mesh data
questions.assumed: Preserve mesh materials and other copied mesh attributes

questions.question: Should this focused repair apply or remove Blender modifiers?
questions.assumed: Leave modifier ownership and application behavior unchanged

questions.question: How should skipped non-mesh parents be reported?
questions.assumed: Keep existing warnings for skipped non-mesh objects

questions.question: What happens if evaluation or baking fails halfway?
questions.assumed: Retain atomic rollback on every failure

questions.question: Should the browser upload request change?
questions.assumed: Keep the existing binary upload and settings headers

questions.question: Should progress and pause behavior change?
questions.assumed: Keep current pause, progress, and completion behavior

questions.question: Where must Blender mutation execute?
questions.assumed: Keep owner-thread dispatch and verify it

questions.question: How deep should the regression run?
options: Uploaded bytes through job, scene, and viewer (Recommended)
questions.assumed: Verify binary upload, completed job, authoritative geometry, and viewer mesh delivery

questions.question: What additional confidence should existing project assets provide?
questions.assumed: Smoke-import every repository .blend after the targeted regression passes
